# Register the tcltest suite as ctest targets.
#
# Each .tcl file becomes its own ctest entry so failures localize, and
# `ctest --label-exclude tcl` can disable the lot in environments
# without the runtime.

find_program(RTC_TCLSH
  NAMES tclsh9.0 tclsh
  REQUIRED)

message(STATUS "rtc/tests/tcl: tclsh = ${RTC_TCLSH}")

# Where pkgIndex.tcl lives, generated by tcl/CMakeLists.txt.
set(_pkg_dir "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:rtc_tcl>")

function(_rtc_add_tcl_test name)
  # tclsh runs the .tcl file directly; each file ends with an exit-on-
  # failure tail so ctest sees a non-zero rc. A `package require rtc`
  # failure during source aborts tclsh with rc != 0 automatically - no
  # driver needed to surface swallowed source errors.
  add_test(NAME tcl_${name}
    COMMAND ${RTC_TCLSH}
      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${name}.tcl
      -verbose "body error")
  set_tests_properties(tcl_${name} PROPERTIES
    LABELS "tcl"
    ENVIRONMENT "TCLLIBPATH=${_pkg_dir}"
    TIMEOUT 60)
endfunction()

_rtc_add_tcl_test(test)
